title: Java Fundamentals Quiz
description: Test your knowledge on Java basics, the JVM, and primitive data types.

questions.questionText: Which of the following makes Java platform-independent?
questions.explanation: The JVM interprets compiled Java bytecode for a specific operating system, making the bytecode platform-independent.

questions.questionText: What is the size of the 'int' primitive data type in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, an 'int' is a 32-bit signed two's complement integer.

questions.questionText: Which tool is used to compile Java source code?
questions.explanation: The 'javac' command compiles .java source files into .class bytecode files.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a primitive data type in Java?
questions.explanation: String is an Object (reference type) in Java, not a primitive data type.

questions.questionText: What is the default value of a boolean variable declared as a class instance variable?
questions.explanation: The default value of a boolean instance variable in Java is false.
JRE stands for Java Runtime Environment, which provides the libraries and JVM needed to execute Java programs.

questions.questionText: Which variable naming convention is the standard best practice in Java?
questions.explanation: Java variables typically follow the camelCase naming convention (e.g., myVariableName).

questions.questionText: What is the output of 'System.out.println(10 / 3);' in Java?
questions.explanation: Since both 10 and 3 are integers, Java performs integer division, discarding the remainder.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to declare a constant variable in Java?
questions.explanation: The 'final' keyword prevents a variable's value from being modified after initial assignment.

questions.questionText: What is the size of the 'char' data type in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, a 'char' is a 16-bit Unicode character.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid declaration of a float variable?
questions.explanation: Float literals must end with an 'f' or 'F', otherwise they are treated as double precision by default.

questions.questionText: What does the 'main' method signature look like in a standard Java application?
questions.explanation: The correct signature is public static void main(String[] args). It is the entry point for the JVM.

questions.questionText: Which of these operators is used for the logical AND operation?
questions.explanation: && is the logical AND operator (short-circuiting), whereas & is a bitwise AND.

questions.questionText: What happens if a local variable is used before it is initialized?
options: It throws an Exception at runtime
questions.explanation: Local variables in Java do not get default values. The compiler will throw an error if you attempt to read an uninitialized local variable.

questions.questionText: In Java, an application must contain at least one...
questions.explanation: Every Java program must have at least one class definition.
